Stranded commuters wade through waist-deep floods at Zapote Junction in Las Piñas City on July 22, 2025, as motorists seek higher ground.

Several parts of Metro Manila were flooded, with many roads rendered impassable to vehicles due to heavy rains and flooding caused by the southwest monsoon.

📸 The STAR/Edd Gumban

RAIN OR SHINE, THE WEDDING CONTINUES ❤️🌧️

Ten-year couple Jao Verdillo and Jam Aguilar continue their wedding ceremony despite flooding at their venue, Our Lady of Mt. Carmel Parish – Barasoain Church in Malolos, Bulacan on Tuesday, July 22. 

The couple insists on pushing through with the wedding despite heavy floods brought by the southwest monsoon, as they reserved the venue two years ago, a location that is difficult to book, and have already taken leave from their jobs as accountants.

📷: Santi San Juan | MB

It’s been known for a long time that trash is one of the major culprits for massive flooding in Metro Manila. A problem that has persisted for decades. One solution to this problem is to amend the Clean Air Act of 1999.

The needed amendment is to remove the ban on incineration of waste. The rationale for this ban has long since passed. Incinerator technology come a long way compared to what was available in 1999. Technologies have already been developed to greatly minimize toxic emissions from burning waste. 

Why should we care?  Because we could just burn the garbage that would otherwise end up clogging our drainage system or going to landfills. The added benefit is we can generate electricity from these incinerators.

Kasama ninyo ang ABS-CBN Foundation Sagip Kapamilya sa paghahanda at pagtutok sa balita upang agad na makapaghatid ng tulong sa mga Kapamilya nating nangangailangan.

Para sa mga nais magbigay ng suporta, narito ang iba’t ibang paraan ng donasyon:

1) Bank Deposit  
2) Scan to Donate options (GCash at Maya: scan thru app. Paypal: scan thru any QR reader)
3) Donation Vouchers sa Shopee at Lazada
4) Donate through BPI eDonate
5) Paypal QR Code para sa International Donations
6) In-Kind Food Donations, at
7) In-Kind Personal Kit Donations

Sa anumang pagsubok, magtulong-tulong tayo Kapamilya! 
Maraming salamat po❤️💚💙
